title: GitLab AI Gateway Critical Patch Release: 19.2.4, 19.3.2, and 19.4.1
description:
We have released versions 19.2.4, 19.3.2, and 19.4.1 of the GitLab AI Gateway.

These versions contain a critical security fix for GitLab Self-Hosted AI Gateway, and we strongly recommend that all GitLab Self-Managed customers with GitLab Self-Hosted AI Gateway installations update to one of these versions immediately. We have conducted targeted outreach to Self-Hosted AI Gateway customers prior to this release post with this guidance.

A fix has already been deployed for GitLab-hosted AI Gateways. Customers using GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, and GitLab Self-Managed instances using a GitLab-hosted AI Gateway are protected and do not need to take action.

Recommended Action

We strongly recommend that all GitLab Self-Hosted AI Gateway installations running a version affected by the issue described below are upgraded to one of the patched versions listed above as soon as possible.
